recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a man in casual outdoor attire, positioned on the right side of the frame and looking away from the camera. The background features a serene lake and forested hills under soft daylight. A prominent two-line typographic block is anchored on the left, featuring a heavy sans-serif font separated by a horizontal line.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned in the right third to balance the heavy text on the left.
Warm tones of the red plaid shirt contrasting with the cool blues and greens of the water and hills.
Horizontal rule in the text block echoing the horizon line of the lake.
Eye-line of the subject directed toward the negative space above the text.
coreInvariants: Red-dominant plaid pattern on the subject's shirt.
A thick horizontal line separating the primary and secondary text lines.
A top border strip in a muted blue-grey tone.
Natural, diffused daylight with soft shadows.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is a medium-close-up, seated on the right, occupying approximately 40% of the horizontal width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold, dark red text block on the left center acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the subject's face, follows his gaze to the left, and then drops down to the bold text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space provided by the water surface in the lower left quadrant.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted blues and greens of the landscape provide a cool-toned backdrop.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red in the shirt and typography provides a warm, high-contrast focal point.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White from the undershirt and water highlights adds brightness.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Naturalistic saturation with a slight matte finish; the red is the most saturated element.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for the display line.
Tight kerning to create a solid block-like appearance.
characterSpecificRedesigns: A small five-pointed star used as a separator between words in the primary line.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with weight and width variations for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule separating the two lines of text.
Top border strip in a contrasting muted color.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, classic American sans-serif feel.
Provides a clean, modern geometric alternative.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a man in his 30s with short dark hair and a beard, wearing a red and black plaid shirt over a white t-shirt and distressed jeans. He is sitting on a rock by a large lake with green hills in the background. The lighting is soft daylight. Leave the left half of the image relatively clear for text. Add a thin muted blue-grey bar at the very top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text in the center-left area using a heavy dark red sans-serif font. Place a thick horizontal red line between the two rows. Use a small star symbol to separate words on the top row.

verificationChecks: Is the subject looking toward the left side of the frame?
Is the text color a consistent deep red?
Is there a clear horizontal rule between the text lines?
Is the top border strip present?

adjustableVariables: Width of the top border strip
mustRedesign: Specific logos in the top right corner
Exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Balanced asymmetry between subject and text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not obscure the subject's face.
Check that the horizontal rule is perfectly level.
Verify the plaid pattern looks realistic and not digitally distorted.
Confirm the top border is a solid, muted color.
recipe.reuseFormula: Outdoor portrait + right-aligned subject + left-aligned heavy sans-serif text block + horizontal rule separator + top color strip.
